title: 第四章 你这是在怨恨本皇？
slug: 神印我魔族太女重铸魔族
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

在阿宝沉沉地睡去之后，枫溪施展一个隔音结界，保障他的睡眠。

看着小小可爱的黑龙崽崽在那呼呼大睡，敞开肚皮，眼眸紧闭的样子，枫溪的唇角上扬着。

枫溪心中的忧愁少了一些。

对于自己母亲的选择，枫溪是认同的。她认为自己的母亲没必要在这泥潭之中继续沦陷，不爱就是不爱，过早的脱身也能让自己的心情好一些。

毕竟，就连她和阿宝的出生也不过是为了传承逆天魔龙族皇族的血脉。

很久之前，枫溪就已经想明白了。因此，她比阿宝更能接受自己母亲的离去。

她凝视阿宝两分钟，在他的气息平稳之后，她转身去书房那边处理政务。

虽然今年的枫溪才十六岁，但她很早之前就展现出自己非凡的统治能力。

十二三岁的时候她就敢一个人孤身一人闯荡魔族境内，了解魔族如今的情况。

如今，她的这份英勇只会更多。

她的胆大，是建立在对自身实力的足够相信的份上。

她正在写着批文，完成今日的政务功课。

魔族教育子嗣的方式跟人类的区别很大。

因为他们是放手的，不过多地干预孩子们的成长。

对于魔族来说，只要孩子们还剩下一口气，他们就不会太在意。

因为魔族的人就是皮糙肉厚，身体就是比人族要坚实。

这就使得魔族的亲缘之情要比人族少很多。

因为他们的投入情感是完全不一样的。

这就导致了魔族的冷血和淡漠，他们已经习惯了用利益去衡量这件事是否能做，就失去了他们的创造性。

这就是魔族如今的情况。

枫溪并不在意那些小事。

她不介意在力所能及的情况下扮演一个好姐姐的角色。

枫溪刚写完三封政务，就听到细微的脚步声。

“殿下。”

穿着一身漆黑长袍的逆天魔龙女护卫单膝跪地，她的脸上蒙着黑色的面纱，露出那双凌厉的黑眸。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

After Abao fell into a deep sleep, Fengxi cast a soundproof barrier to protect his sleep.

Seeing the cute little black dragon cub sleeping soundly there, with its belly open and eyes closed, the corners of Feng Xi's lips raised.

The sadness in Fengxi's heart became less.

Fengxi agreed with his mother's choice.She believes that there is no need for her mother to continue to sink into this quagmire. If she doesn't love her, she doesn't love her. Getting out prematurely can make her feel better.

After all, even she and Abao were born just to pass on the blood of the royal family of the Heaven-defying Demonic Dragon Clan.

Fengxi had figured it out a long time ago.Therefore, she is more able to accept her mother's death than Po.

She stared at Abao for two minutes. After his breathing stabilized, she turned around and went to the study to handle government affairs.

Although Fengxi is only sixteen years old this year, she has shown her extraordinary dominance ability very early on.

When she was twelve or thirteen years old, she dared to wander into the territory of the Demon Clan alone to understand the current situation of the Demon Clan.

Now, her bravery only grows more.

Her boldness is based on sufficient belief in her own strength.

She is writing approval documents and completing today's government homework.

The way demons educate their children is very different from humans.

Because they are hands-off and do not interfere too much in the growth of children.

For the demons, as long as the children are still alive, they don't care too much.

Because people from the demon race have rough skin and thick flesh, and their bodies are stronger than those from the human race.

This makes the demons have much less kinship than the humans.

Because their investment emotions are completely different.

This has led to the cold-bloodedness and indifference of the demons. They have become accustomed to using profits to measure whether something can be done, and have lost their creativity.

This is the current situation of the demon clan.

Fengxi doesn't care about those little things.

She doesn't mind playing the role of a good sister when she can.

Fengxi had just finished writing three government letters when he heard subtle footsteps.

"Your Highness."

The female guard of the heaven-defying demon dragon in a jet-black robe knelt on one knee. Her face was covered with a black veil, revealing her sharp black eyes.
